ext_name.description: Extension name shown in the toolbar and the Web Store.

ext_desc.message: Blocks ad and tracking requests, hides ad slots, interstitial and pop-up ads — with custom rules, a site whitelist and stats.

popup_site_label.description: Label above the current site hostname.

popup_site_toggle.message: Pause or resume blocking on this site

popup_opt_overlay.description: Toggle: kill interstitial and overlay ads.

popup_foot_live.message: Hiding and rule changes apply instantly

popup_foot_net_limited.message: Network counts work only when the extension is loaded unpacked
popup_foot_net_limited.description: Popup footnote when declarativeNetRequestFeedback is unavailable.

popup_foot_applied.message: Rules and hiding apply instantly — no need to reload the page
popup_foot_applied.description: Popup footnote when network counting is available.

popup_page_unsupported.description: Shown instead of a hostname on restricted pages.

popup_hint_builtin.message: Can't block on browser pages (chrome://, the Web Store, …)

popup_hint_paused.message: Blocking is paused here (manage the whitelist in All settings)
popup_hint_paused.description: Per-site hint when the site is whitelisted.

popup_hint_off.message: Master switch is off — blocking is paused everywhere
popup_hint_off.description: Per-site hint when the master switch is off.

popup_hint_active.description: Per-site hint while blocking is active.

popup_state_paused.description: Summary line when blocking is paused.

popup_state_done.description: Summary line: how many items were handled on this page.

popup_state_none.description: Summary line when nothing was blocked yet.

popup_demo.message: Demo mode: this is not an extension environment, actions have no effect
popup_demo.description: Popup footnote when the page is opened outside the extension.

options_welcome_text.message: The extension is running. Below you can tune what gets blocked, manage the whitelist and write custom rules.

options_scope_desc.message: Request blocking uses Chrome's declarative rules. It never reads page content, so it stays fast and battery friendly.

row_master_desc.message: When off, blocking is paused on every site

row_ads_desc.message: Google ads, ad exchanges and native ad networks (Taboola / Outbrain and others)

row_trackers_desc.message: Third-party analytics, pixels, ad verification and session-recording scripts

row_annoyances_desc.message: Background requests for push subscriptions and Cookie/GDPR consent dialogs (off by default)

row_video_desc.message: Ad endpoints on Youku, iQIYI, Bilibili and similar sites

warn_playback.description: Inline warning in the video row.

interstitial_desc.message: For full-screen ads that appear while you browse: Google vignettes and interstitials, floating layers, popunders and click-triggered side drawers. Blocking also removes the dim overlay, clears the page blur and restores scrolling.

row_overlay.message: Block interstitial, floating and pop-up ads

row_overlay_desc.message: Hides overlay containers found via Google ad markers and ad-related class names

row_popup_desc.message: Blocks ad windows opened by scripts through window.open — pop-ups you open yourself are untouched

cleanup_desc.message: Element hiding runs live inside the page, so every switch takes effect immediately.

row_hide_desc.message: Hides common ad containers, ad iframes and empty placeholders so pages do not keep big gaps

row_sponsored_desc.message: Detects “sponsored / promoted” items on Weibo, Zhihu, Douyin, Facebook, X, Reddit and more

row_cookie_desc.message: Hides OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi consent dialogs and unlocks scrolling (may affect a few sites)

row_aggressive_desc.message: Turns on broader selectors and floating-ad heuristics

warn_misfire.message: may hide elements it should not
warn_misfire.description: Inline warning in the aggressive row.

row_badge.message: Show blocked count on the icon

row_badge_desc.message: Turn off to hide the number badge

allowlist_desc.message: One domain per line; subdomains are included automatically. Whitelisted sites are never blocked or modified.

allowlist_count.description: How many domains are on the whitelist.

allowlist_tip.message: You can also pause the current site from the toolbar pop-up

rules_desc.message: One rule per line — the usual Adblock syntax is supported:

syntax_types.message: block only script and image requests

syntax_hide_all.message: hide matching elements on every site

syntax_hide_site.message: hide matching elements only on the given site

rules_warn.message: Some rules could not be parsed and were ignored
rules_warn.description: Warning shown when some custom rules could not be parsed.

count_rules.description: Rule count badge next to a rule set name.

footer_enabled.message: AdShield v$version$ — network counting enabled (extension loaded in developer mode)
footer_enabled.description: Options footer when network counting works.

footer_limited.message: AdShield v$version$ — network counting unavailable (no declarativeNetRequestFeedback permission)
footer_limited.description: Options footer when network counting is unavailable.

version_line.message: All changes save and apply instantly (v$version$)
version_line.description: Options subtitle with the extension version.

version_demo.message: Demo mode: this is not an extension environment, changes are not saved
version_demo.description: Options subtitle when opened outside the extension.

confirm_reset.message: Reset to defaults? The whitelist and custom rules will be cleared.

err_invalid_host.description: Error passed to the popup when a hostname cannot be parsed.

err_page_unavailable.message: This page cannot be reached (restricted page or not fully loaded)
err_page_unavailable.description: Error passed to the popup when the content script cannot be reached.

err_unknown_command.description: Error for an unknown runtime message.
